title: Explain a zero replenishment quantity
steps: Review the Computer XP4523 row in the loaded physical-stock list, then hover over its To order quantity.

video_guide.summary: Review why an under-target product remains listed while no extra order is needed.

chapters.note: The row shows physical stock 110, desired stock 200, ordered quantity 100, and To order 0.
The tooltip says the quantity is zero because enough quantity has already been ordered.
The same tooltip and zero quantity remain visible; the page also describes the physical-stock listing threshold.
